from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, signal
signal.alarm(120)
p = Path("/home/ningyd/文档/ChatGPT/BIGsmall/tests/test_visual_verification_repository.py")
b = p.read_bytes()
assert len(b) == 29485
assert hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest() == 'c892ad672b82ce5d57b25beee008ea913e446a73d45d46da5b48b1f7dbc1ab74'
lines = b.decode('utf-8').splitlines()
assert len(lines) == 732
excerpt = '\n'.join(f'{i+1}:{line}' for i, line in enumerate(lines[:110]))
out = {'path': str(p), 'bytes': len(b), 'sha256': hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(), 'start_line': 1, 'end_line': 110, 'text': excerpt, 'product_execution': False}
encoded = json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False)
assert len((encoded + '\n').encode('utf-8')) <= 24000
print(encoded)
signal.alarm(0)
